name: fa
description: 기본적분석 계산기 — DART 재무제표 rows 를 받아 수익성·안정성·성장성 비율과 (시총을 주면) PER·PBR·PSR 을 계산합니다. 한투 종목추정실적을 주면 증권사 전망을 과거실적과 나란히 정규화합니다. 수집은 dart·korea-invest, 계산은 여기 — 없는 값은 지어내지 않고 null 입니다.

actions.name: 재무비율 계산 (수익성·안정성·성장성·밸류에이션)
actions.description: DART statement rows in -> profitability (margins, ROE, ROA), stability (debt ratio, current ratio, equity ratio), growth (YoY revenue/profit/assets), and with marketCap also PER/PBR/PSR (+EPS/BPS with shares)

params.statements: DART fnlttSinglAcnt/All rows (or statementsCacheKey from the dart call)
params.marketCap: market capitalization in KRW for valuation ratios
params.shares: listed share count for per-share figures
params.estimates: KIS 국내주식-187 response as-is, or estimatesCacheKey from that call (optional) — adds broker estimates; never rebuild rows by hand

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline checks against synthetic DART-shaped rows with known answers.

action.description: ratios = DART statement rows -> financial ratios. selftest = offline checks.

statements.description: Rows exactly as the dart module returns them (financial / financialAll): account_nm + thstrm_amount / frmtrm_amount / bfefrmtrm_amount, optional fs_div. CFS (연결) is preferred when both appear.

statementsCacheKey.description: The `_cacheKey` from the dart financial call — a top-level parameter of its own, never a value inside `statements`. Hands the rows over without re-inlining them. One of statements / statementsCacheKey is required. Several calls (one per year) may be listed — ["key2023","key2024","key2025"] — and their rows are concatenated in the order given.

marketCap.description: Market capitalization in KRW (current price x listed shares). Enables PER/PBR/PSR. Get the price from a broker/quote tool — this module does not fetch.

shares.description: Listed share count — enables EPS/BPS/SPS per-share figures.

estimates.description: KIS 국내주식-187 (estimate-perform) response data as-is — output1..output4 — OR pass estimatesCacheKey with the _cacheKey from that call (preferred: no retyping). The output2/output3 rows are UNLABELED — never try to decode row meanings yourself (the labels here are live-measured), and never rebuild rows by hand; a hand-made array is refused, not normalized. Adds a normalized analyst-estimates section (revenue/op/net + YoY, EPS/PER/ROE, E-flagged periods, analyst + opinion). KIS rate convention (x10) is undone here; unlabeled indicator rows are dropped, never guessed.
